question: Is there any foreshadowing you are confident nobody will notice until it's finally revealed?
answer:
I'm one person, while the readers are many, so there isn't a mystery that can't be uncovered if you make use of collective intelligence! (laughs)

I'm not just saying that because I lost, but making sure things don't get figured out isn't actually my priority, so I don't think there will be anything that remains completely incomprehensible until the very end.

That said, regarding the larger ongoing mysteries and pieces of foreshadowing in Re:Zero, until they're revealed, I do try to prevent one particular interpretation from becoming overwhelmingly dominant. I think I've been able to control that fairly well!
